current.text: Spencer is projected to come off the bench. The projected bench is Pippen, Wells, Stewart, GG Jackson and Spencer.
Ty Jerome has started both preseason games at point guard.
The Memphis guard group is crowded with Javon Small, Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr. and Campazzo, so his minutes are uncertain.
Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation with short stints, which limits bench minutes.
He needs many players out of the way to matter in fantasy. Part of his value last season came from absences in Memphis.
Memphis has 4 games in each of our playoff weeks through March 28 and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is a low-usage passer who adds assists and threes without many shots.
Experts rate him as a very efficient mid-range and three-point shooter, but on low volume.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN put his value at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 226, ESPN rank 143). With 144 players drafted, he is not a draft target in our league. Last season he played 23.8 minutes and averaged 5.6 assists and 2.0 threes at 94% FT, but he projects as a bench guard behind Jerome in a deep, short-stint rotation. Leave him on waivers and watch Memphis guard injuries early. If he gets starter minutes, his assists, threes, FT% and low turnovers fit guard-heavy builds, and Memphis has a full 4-4-4 playoff schedule.
